text:
rachel_sales: quick sales->CS handoff for Solaris Markets (mid-market retail). Demo mostly positive but three high-priority asks: SAML SSO, a short private-eval window in Feb, and a reserved-capacity estimate with committed discount. renewal date: 2026-02-28. Customer says they need ~15% cost reduction.

rachel_sales: During the demo they hit intermittent HTTP 500s on long invoice generation calls. Example (sanitized):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-1","prompt":"<long invoice + history>","max_tokens":1200}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
# x-request-id: req_5c3f7a9d
```

jamie_cs: thanks Rachel. i'll run onboarding kickoff and own enablement. tagging owners: @oliver_cs_manager for pricing/renewal, @maya_support for triage, @devon_engineer for runtime mitigation.

oliver_cs_manager: will assemble three reserved-capacity scenarios (small commit, medium w/ burst, annual) + private-eval pricing. target Tue COB. looping in finance.

infra-bot: INF-5011 created by maya_support (P2). https://issues.redwood.dev/INF-5011

maya_support: repro attempt in staging produced "kernel_launch_failed -> CUDA out of memory" on A100. attached logs to INF-5011. temporary workaround: lowering max_tokens to 800 cleared the error in staging.

devon_engineer: plausible root cause: KV cache pressure or large-kernel OOM for long sequences. quick mitigation: suggest routing fallback to redwood-medium-1 for estimated sequences >1024 and enable prefix caching. i'll prototype a routing rule and PR.

jamie_cs: owners & immediate next steps:
- Kickoff (owner: jamie_cs) 10am Mon PT with customer SSO contact.
- Support triage (owner: maya_support) 18:00 today 14:00 UTC : attach full logs to INF-5011.
- Eng mitigation (owner: devon_engineer) 24h : fallback rule PR + short writeup.
- Commercial estimate (owner: oliver_cs_manager) Tue COB.

rachel_sales: shared demo recording + contract in folder: https://files.redwood.example/solaris-handshake (cs/support/eng). Please capture latency baselines (95p token) and cost per 1M tokens for medium+large models and quantized variants in the deck.

oliver_cs_manager: will include latency/cost slide and a renewal outreach draft.

maya_support: added prefix-caching config and staging artifacts to INF-5011. temporary mitigation note included.

devon_engineer: opened PR for routing fallback (WIP): https://git.redwood.dev/routing/PR-710. will link CI once green.

jamie_cs: adding playbook bullets: "SSO required pre-prod", "price-sensitive: favors committed discount", "needs predictable latency on long invoices". created JIRA CS-5120 for onboarding + renewal tasks. owners: jamie_cs / oliver_cs_manager.

rachel_sales: thanks everyone 1 please keep INF-5011 and CS-5120 updated. escalate to me if we miss the exec check-in window.

maya_support: will post final root-cause summary in INF-5011 after eng confirms. :white_check_mark:

devon_engineer: will post mitigation details + test results to INF-5011 and CS-5120 after CI.

jamie_cs: closing handoff thread; will reopen after kickoff scheduled. :lock:
